format: Unified instruction-tuning JSON for Chinese modular harmful meme detection.

fields.input: Textual input consumed by the current LLM pipeline.
fields.output: Gold answer. For unlabeled test sets this is an empty string.
fields.label: Binary label when available. 1 means harmful/toxic/misogyny/offensive for the task.
fields.label_text: Chinese verbalizer, 是 for positive and 否 for negative.

tasks.hate_semantics: M1, Chinese toxic-language classification on ToxiCN.
tasks.visual_expression: M3, meme-meaning interpretation on emo-visual-data from VLM-generated image descriptions.
tasks.met_m3_toxicn_reasoning: M2, hateful-meme reasoning on MET-Meme (Chinese) and the Weibo subset of M3, deduplicated against the ToxiCN-MM test set.
tasks.met_m3_sarcnet_reasoning: M2, hateful-meme reasoning on MET-Meme (Chinese) and the Weibo subset of M3, deduplicated against the SarcNet test set.
tasks.sarcasm_detection: Target benchmark, Chinese subset of SarcNet.
